name: enigmagent-mcp
description: Local encrypted vault MCP server with safe metadata-only defaults and explicit trusted-client raw resolution.
long_description: EnigmAgent stores entries using Argon2id-derived AES-256-GCM keys, exposes metadata without values by default, bounds opt-in raw resolution to a caller-declared origin, and provides an authenticated local REST transport with bounded requests. The caller-declared origin is not attestation; raw resolution must only be enabled for a trusted client.

vault_path.title: Vault file
vault_path.description: Absolute path to your encrypted vault (my.vault.json).

enigmagent_user.title: Username (optional, headless mode)
enigmagent_user.description: Skip interactive prompt. Leave empty to be prompted on first use.

enigmagent_pass.title: Master password (optional, headless mode)
enigmagent_pass.description: Skip interactive prompt. Sensitive — leave empty to be prompted on first use.

tools.description: Opt-in trusted-client resolution of a {{PLACEHOLDER}} to its real value (origin-bound). Disabled by default.

tools.description: List secret names and bound domains (values never returned).
